purpose: The one source for every research figure on the website. scripts/build-research-sections.mjs renders the homepage and Decision Proof blocks from this file; nothing else may hard-code a research statistic.
publicationRule: Public pages render a finding only when publication.status is APPROVED and every blocker is cleared. Everything else renders only in the local internal preview (marketing-preview/, git-ignored, never deployed).

relatedPullRequests.subject: Decision accountability record and checkpoint measurement

synchronization.updateProcedure: When #1024 returns authorized D7/D14/D30 results, add them as findings with classification INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED_OUTCOME (or PROVIDER_REPORTED_OUTCOME), set the horizon status in accountability.horizons, bump version, run the build, and record the approval. No layout change is needed.

classifications.MEASURED_RESEARCH: Counted directly from a recorded research run. Describes what was examined, not what will happen.
classifications.DIAGNOSTIC_COMPARISON: A comparison between two estimates of the same thing. Neither side is independent market truth; it is not valuation accuracy.
classifications.MODELED_ECONOMIC: Arithmetic on stated assumptions (fees, fulfilment, a reference price). Not a realized gain or loss.
classifications.SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION: Software tests on invented data. Proves rules are applied consistently; says nothing about market accuracy.
classifications.INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED_OUTCOME: A later market outcome measured from an authorized independent source or named verifier and compared with a frozen Day-0 decision.
classifications.PROVIDER_REPORTED_OUTCOME: A later outcome reported by one licensed provider only. Shown as provider-reported, never as measured.

publicationStatuses.APPROVED: Founder-approved and every rights blocker cleared. May render on public pages.
publicationStatuses.INTERNAL_PREVIEW: Reconciled to its source, but not approved for publication. Preview only.
publicationStatuses.UNRECONCILED: The figure could not be traced to a FlipForge record. Never rendered as a finding; the internal preview names it only in its reconciliation note.
publicationStatuses.WITHDRAWN: Previously published and withdrawn. Never rendered.

caseStudies.title: The $280 bargain that wasn’t.

facts.referenceWindow: about the latest 45 days (provider limit of 100 sales reached)
facts.secondReferenceLabel: a second provider's qualified median, Nov 23 (15 sales)

caseStudies.closing: The price looked right. Waiting may have been the better decision.
limitations: A historical research case with a modeled outcome. Not a realized customer loss and not an independently verified checkpoint.
The $280 'discount' was measured against FlipForge's own earlier value of $1,225, which newer evidence did not support. The case shows FlipForge's evidence being challenged, not only the listing.
FlipForge returned WATCH, not BUY. Its reconsideration price was $925.33; buying there would also model a loss ($137.76) against the $911 reference.
The $911 reference covers about the latest 45 days of one provider's sales; FlipForge's $1,225 used a 90-day window. Why the two differ is still being investigated.

blockers: Hobby Card Index written permission for the $911 reference in marketing
No card image without image rights (the case uses type only)

decisionFiles.title: A decision you can hold accountable: Day 0, 7, 14 and 30.
decisionFiles.summary: Every saved decision is frozen at Day 0 and reviewed at Days 7, 14 and 30. Outcomes count only when an authorized independent source confirms them; until then the result is pending.

accountability.rule: An outcome counts only when an authorized independent source or a named verifier confirms it. One provider alone is shown as provider-reported. Unknown outcomes are never counted as wins or losses, and completed software testing is never shown as purchasing accuracy.

comparison.title: More than a price. A decision.
comparison.note: A comparison of two approaches to the same purchase, not of any specific product. Many tools offer some of these capabilities.

proof100.reconciliation: Proof100 (Sept 9-10, 2026) remains withdrawn: it was frozen on a build later found to have an evidence-classification defect, and under the current eligibility standard its checkpoints have no independently verified outcomes. None of its figures may be displayed. A new cohort frozen on the corrected build must establish any future claim.
